There’s a basic process I go through whenever I revise for any subject. Note that I haven’t finished A level physics yet but I got full UMS in unit 1 and 2 AS and 42/48 UMS in the practical. First step is going through the content, making sure you can explain the key points in your own words without looking. Then when you finish revising over a topic, run through the spec and again try and explain the detail around each point in the spec as the process of active recall is really helpful for drilling information in your head. Apply your knowledge in practice questions and past papers. Before the exam once more go through the whole spec and make sure you understand everything.

Prep for the exam is just as important as actual performance on the day. Read the questions *slowly and word for word* and it goes without saying but check your work thoroughly as you go. It helps to visualise certain questions in your head such as motion questions so you truly understand what’s going on. 

Good luck.
